description: A synthetic feature uses a verified configuration within its intended environment.
safe_action: Accept the configuration because its provenance is verified and environment isolation is preserved.

description: A feature is intentionally disabled through a verified configuration.
safe_action: Accept the disabled feature state because the configuration is verified and intentional.

description: A required configuration is missing and the system safely disables the affected feature.
safe_action: Apply the safe default and retain audit evidence until the missing configuration has been reviewed.

description: The active configuration differs from the approved baseline.
safe_action: Review the configuration difference against the approved baseline before authorising further changes.

description: A configuration intended for one environment is unexpectedly applied to another.
safe_action: Block the configuration because environment isolation has failed and restore an independently verified baseline.

description: A feature has been enabled without sufficient configuration audit evidence.
safe_action: Block the unverified feature activation until configuration provenance and authorisation can be established.

description: An invalid configuration is detected and the feature is safely disabled.
safe_action: Preserve the fail-safe state and correct the invalid configuration before re-enabling the feature.

description: A previously detected configuration difference has been corrected and verified.
safe_action: Accept the corrected configuration because baseline consistency and audit evidence have been restored.
